segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today we're talking about a kind of education that is quite unique actually a little bit different from the kind of education that most people get.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们谈论的是一种非常独特的教育，实际上与大多数人接受的教育类型有些不同。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we normally go to school to learn but on this occasion we're going to talk about a different way of obtaining your education.
segments.zh: 所以我们通常去学校学习，但在这种情况下，我们将讨论一种不同的方式来获得你的教育。

segments.en: We're talking about homeschooling someone.
segments.zh: 我们谈论的是在家上学。

segments.en: Let's check this word out in today's vocabulary preview.
segments.zh: 让我们在今天的词汇预览中查看这个词。

segments.en: Vocabulary preview.
segments.zh: 词汇预习。

segments.en: Alright so the word is homeschool, to homeschool someone.
segments.zh: 好吧，这个词是在家上学，在家上学的人。

segments.en: It's I guess a verb.
segments.zh: 我猜是动词。

segments.en: And what does it mean if you're homeschooled?
segments.zh: 如果你在家上学，这意味着什么？

segments.en: Well you think about the word school, home, it means that you study at home.
segments.zh: 好吧，你想想学校这个词，这意味着你在家学习。

segments.en: But you don't go to school every day.
segments.zh: 但你不是每天都去上学。

segments.en: Instead you have a parent or maybe a friend of a parent who comes to your house to teach you every day.
segments.zh: 相反，你有一个父母，或者一个父母的朋友，他们每天都来你家教你。

segments.en: So it's basically like having a tutor for but not to help you with school but to actually teach you everything that you learn at school.
segments.zh: 所以这基本上就像有一个导师，但不是为了帮助你上学，而是真正教你在学校学到的一切。

segments.en: That's right and some people are homeschooled with their siblings, so brothers and sisters.
segments.zh: 没错，有些人和他们的兄弟姐妹一起在家上学，所以兄弟姐妹。

segments.en: Other people are homeschooled alone.
segments.zh: 其他人独自在家上学。

segments.en: We'll talk about some of these things in a moment but let's take a listen to our dialogue.
segments.zh: 我们稍后会讨论其中的一些事情，但让我们听听我们的对话。

segments.en: I think we should homeschool our children when we decide to have kids.
segments.zh: 以后有了孩子，我觉得我们应该让他们在家接受教育。

segments.en: What?
segments.zh: 什么？

segments.en: Why?
segments.zh: 为什么？

segments.en: Well our public schools here are not very good and private schools are just too expensive.
segments.zh: 我们这里公立学校不怎么样，私立学校又太贵。

segments.en: I've been reading up on some homeschooling and it has a lot of advantages.
segments.zh: 我最近查了些在家教育的资料，发现有不少好处。

segments.en: Like what?
segments.zh: 比如什么？

segments.en: I think that by doing something like that we would be isolating our children from social interaction.
segments.zh: 我觉得这样会让孩子缺少与人交往的机会。

segments.en: Well first of all I would be able to teach them everything they learn in school in a more relaxed and fun way.
segments.zh: 首先，我可以用更轻松有趣的方式教他们学校里的知识。

segments.en: I also think that having a one-on-one class is much better since you can focus more on his or her strengths or weaknesses.
segments.zh: 而且一对一教学更好，可以针对孩子的长处和弱项来教。

segments.en: I think neither your parents or mine would agree to such an idea.
segments.zh: 我觉得你我两边的父母都不会同意。

segments.en: I'll bring it up over Sunday brunch.
segments.zh: 周日吃早午餐时，我会提起这事。

segments.en: Good luck with that.
segments.zh: 那祝你好运。

segments.en: All right we're back so now let's take a look at some of that language on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们回来了，所以现在让我们来看看语言外卖中的一些语言。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: So as we mentioned in the introduction to today's podcast, homeschooling is one of many different educational options.
segments.zh: 因此，正如我们在今天的播客介绍中提到的那样，在家上学是许多不同的教育选择之一。

segments.en: The most common ones are, in the beginning of the dialogue, public and private school.
segments.zh: 最常见的是，在对话开始时，公立和私立学校。

segments.en: So in most places you will have public schools where basically the education is paid for by the government.
segments.zh: 因此，在大多数地方，您将拥有公立学校，基本上由政府支付教育费用。

segments.en: Yeah, that's right.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: So public schools are schools that are available to all students.
segments.zh: 所以公立学校是所有学生都可以使用的学校。

segments.en: You don't have to pay to attend them.
segments.zh: 您无需付费即可参加。

segments.en: This is of course in America.
segments.zh: 这当然是在美国。

segments.en: In Britain the system is a bit different.
segments.zh: 在英国，这个系统有点不同。

segments.en: But in America you have the public schools which most kids go to.
segments.zh: 但在美国，你有大多数孩子去的公立学校。

segments.en: Of course if your parents don't want you to study in public school there's another option that's called private school.
segments.zh: 当然，如果您的父母不希望您在公立学校学习，还有另一种选择，称为私立学校。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Private school as the name says, it's not really private but what happens is that it's not available free for everyone.
segments.zh: 私立学校 顾名思义，它不是真正的私立学校，但发生的是它不是每个人都可以免费使用的。

segments.en: You have to actually pay to go to the school.
segments.zh: 你必须付钱才能去学校。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: The school has a tuition, kind of like a private college or university.
segments.zh: 学校有学费，有点像私立学院或大学。

segments.en: So you have to pay every semester or every year.
segments.zh: 所以你必须每学期或每年支付一次。

segments.en: And usually these schools also have application standards.
segments.zh: 通常这些学校也有申请标准。

segments.en: So they interview you, they interview your parents.
segments.zh: 所以他们采访你，他们采访你的父母。

segments.en: So there's a lot of different things you have to do to attend these schools.
segments.zh: 所以你必须做很多不同的事情才能上这些学校。

segments.en: So they're a bit more exclusive.
segments.zh: 所以它们更独特。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So these are basically some three options you have.
segments.zh: 所以这些基本上是你有的三个选项。

segments.en: Homeschooling, public schools, private schools.
segments.zh: 在家上学，公立学校，私立学校。

segments.en: And well the two parents are kind of discussing the options of why it would be maybe not a good idea to homeschool one of the kids.
segments.zh: 好吧，这两个父母正在讨论为什么在家上学可能不是一个孩子的好主意的选择。

segments.en: And she says that it would be isolating our children from social interaction.
segments.zh: 她说这将把我们的孩子与社交互动隔离开来。

segments.en: Alright.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So let's take a look at the word to isolate.
segments.zh: 所以让我们看看这个词来隔离。

segments.en: This is a verb.
segments.zh: 这是个动词。

segments.en: And I like to think of island, isolate, kind of similar in a way.
segments.zh: 我喜欢在某种程度上想到岛屿、孤立、有点相似。

segments.en: Basically to isolate from is to keep away from.
segments.zh: 基本上隔离就是要远离。

segments.en: So if your student or your child is being homeschooled, he or she might be isolated from other students.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您的学生或您的孩子在家上学，他或她可能会与其他学生隔离。

segments.en: They're not near or with other students.
segments.zh: 他们不在附近或与其他学生在一起。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So to isolate means to keep away from or to keep separately.
segments.zh: 所以隔离意味着远离或单独保留。

segments.en: So like you said, maybe if you're on an island, you are isolated from the rest of the world.
segments.zh: 就像你说的，也许如果你在一个岛上，你就会与世界其他地方隔绝。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: I live in the country far away from the city.
segments.zh: 我住在远离城市的国家。

segments.en: I feel isolated from other people.
segments.zh: 我感到与其他人隔绝。

segments.en: So she's saying that the kid might be isolated from social interaction.
segments.zh: 所以她说这个孩子可能会与社交互动隔离开来。

segments.en: Alright.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Now, social interaction.
segments.zh: 现在，社交互动。

segments.en: This is a two-word phrase.
segments.zh: 这是一个两个词的短语。

segments.en: We usually take it as a phrase.
segments.zh: 我们通常把它当作一个短语。

segments.en: This basically means talking to or playing with other people, other kids.
segments.zh: 这基本上意味着与其他人、其他孩子交谈或玩耍。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So I guess in this case, it's personal or physical social interaction because nowadays we have social interaction via the internet.
segments.zh: 所以我想在这种情况下，这是个人或身体的社交互动，因为现在我们通过互联网进行了社交互动。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: But in the case of a student going to school, it would be of course playing on the playground, attending class.
segments.zh: 但如果学生上学，当然是在操场上玩耍，上课。

segments.en: But social interaction means talking to or being with other people.
segments.zh: 但社交互动意味着与他人交谈或与他人在一起。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Well, and the other parent argued that there are many advantages and specifically he said that having a one-on-one class is better for the kids.
segments.zh: 好吧，另一位家长争辩说有很多优势，他特别说，有一对一的课程对孩子来说更好。

segments.en: Alright, so this word one-on-one refers to one teacher, one student.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以这个词一对一指的是一位老师，一位学生。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: One parent, one child.
segments.zh: 一位家长，一位孩子。

segments.en: It means when you're talking to someone and there's no one else around.
segments.zh: 这意味着当您与某人交谈并且周围没有其他人时。

segments.en: Alright, so usually tutors teach you one-on-one.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以通常导师会一对一教你。

segments.en: You sit at a table and your tutor helps you study.
segments.zh: 你坐在一张桌子旁，你的导师帮助你学习。

segments.en: But in the case of homeschooling, the student learns one-on-one.
segments.zh: 但在家庭教育的情况下，学生可以一对一学习。

segments.en: So learns directly from the teacher.
segments.zh: 所以直接从老师那里学到。

segments.en: Right, and that's different from public schools obviously because you have one teacher for maybe 30 students.
segments.zh: 是的，这显然与公立学校不同，因为您可能有一位老师可以容纳 30 名学生。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So that's one-on-one.
segments.zh: 所以这是一对一的。

segments.en: That's one-on-many.
segments.zh: 那是一对多的。

segments.en: Right, exactly.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: But one-on-one is also a word you can use when you talk about meetings.
segments.zh: 但是一对一也是你在谈论会议时可以使用的一个词。

segments.en: So you could say, hey Marco, can we have a one-on-one meeting later?
segments.zh: 所以你可以说，嘿，马可，我们以后可以举行一对一的会议吗？

segments.en: I'd like to talk to you alone.
segments.zh: 我想和你一个人谈谈。

segments.en: So that means I'm not going to talk to you with other people around.
segments.zh: 所以这意味着我不会和你周围的其他人谈谈。

segments.en: Right, okay, it's like a private meeting.
segments.zh: 对，好吧，这就像一个私人会议。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So let's take a listen to the dialogue again and then we're going to come back and we're going to take a look at some key phrases.
segments.zh: 所以让我们再听一遍对话，然后我们会回来，我们将看看一些关键短语。

segments.en: I think we should homeschool our children when we decide to have kids.
segments.zh: 以后有了孩子，我觉得我们应该让他们在家接受教育。

segments.en: What?
segments.zh: 什么？

segments.en: Why?
segments.zh: 为什么？

segments.en: Well, our public schools here are not very good and private schools are just too expensive.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们这里的公立学校不是很好，私立学校也太贵了。

segments.en: I have been reading up on some homeschooling and it has a lot of advantages.
segments.zh: 我一直在阅读一些家庭教育，它有很多优势。

segments.en: Like what?
segments.zh: 比如什么？

segments.en: I think that by doing something like that we would be isolating our children from social interaction.
segments.zh: 我觉得这样会让孩子缺少与人交往的机会。

segments.en: Well, first of all, I would be able to teach them everything they learn in school in a more relaxed and fun way.
segments.zh: 好吧，首先，我可以以更轻松、更有趣的方式教他们在学校学到的一切。

segments.en: I also think that having a one-on-one class is much better since you can focus more on his or her strengths or weaknesses.
segments.zh: 而且一对一教学更好，可以针对孩子的长处和弱项来教。

segments.en: I think neither your parents or mine would agree to such an idea.
segments.zh: 我觉得你我两边的父母都不会同意。

segments.en: I'll bring it up over Sunday brunch.
segments.zh: 周日吃早午餐时，我会提起这事。

segments.en: Good luck with that.
segments.zh: 那祝你好运。

segments.en: All right, we've picked out four key phrases for you today.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们今天为您挑选了四个关键短语。

segments.en: Let's take a look at those on Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 让我们来看看那些关于 Fluency Builder 的内容。

segments.en: Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 流利表达。

segments.en: So the first phrase today in Fluency Builder is the phrase to read up on.
segments.zh: 所以今天在 Fluency Builder 中的第一个短语是可以阅读的短语。

segments.en: So the sentence was, I've been reading up on homeschooling and it has a lot of advantages.
segments.zh: 所以这句话是，我一直在阅读关于家庭教育的内容，它有很多优点。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So basically if you say you have been reading up on a subject or a topic or something, it means that you've been reading about it, you've kind of been informing yourself.
segments.zh: 所以基本上，如果你说你一直在阅读一个主题或一个主题或其他东西，这意味着你一直在阅读它，你一直在告诉自己。

segments.en: You're doing research about a topic.
segments.zh: 你正在研究一个主题。

segments.en: So in this case, one parent is researching the homeschooling option.
segments.zh: 因此，在这种情况下，一位家长正在研究家庭教育选项。

segments.en: So here she is reading maybe articles in a magazine or books or looking on the internet.
segments.zh: 所以在这里她可能正在阅读杂志或书籍或在互联网上浏览的文章。

segments.en: But you don't actually just have to read up on education.
segments.zh: 但你实际上不必只阅读教育。

segments.en: You can read up on anything, right?
segments.zh: 你可以阅读任何内容，对吧？

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So you can read up on anything that interests you or you can do research on anything.
segments.zh: 因此，您可以阅读任何您感兴趣的内容，或者您可以对任何事情进行研究。

segments.en: So you can read up on dinosaurs, for example.
segments.zh: 例如，您可以阅读恐龙。

segments.en: I've been reading up on dinosaurs lately.
segments.zh: 我最近一直在阅读恐龙。

segments.en: And did you know that the brontosaurus is not a real dinosaur anymore?
segments.zh: 你知道雷龙不是真正的恐龙吗？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay, so we've been reading up on the advantages of homeschooling and he starts by, well, defending his position on what the advantages are with the phrase.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我们一直在阅读家庭教育的优势，他首先捍卫他对这句话的优势的立场。

segments.en: Well, first of all.
segments.zh: 嗯，首先。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: This is an important little phrase.
segments.zh: 这是一个重要的小词。

segments.en: This is something you can use, like you say, Marco, when you're going to have an argument or maybe a discussion about something and you want to tell your points, your side of the argument.
segments.zh: 这是你可以使用的东西，就像你说的，马可，当你要讨论某事或讨论某事并且你想告诉你的观点，你的论点时。

segments.en: And so first of all means I have a list, but this is my first point.
segments.zh: 所以首先意味着我有一个清单，但这是我的第一点。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So it's a nice little phrase to open up this list of things that you're going to say, right?
segments.zh: 所以这是一个很好的小短语来打开你要说的这个列表，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So you should drink orange juice, Marco, because first of all, it tastes good, but second of all, or, but also it's very good for your body.
segments.zh: 所以你应该喝橙汁，Marco，因为首先它的味道很好，但其次，或者，它对你的身体也非常有好处。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So first of all is the first main point.
segments.zh: 所以首先是第一个要点。

segments.en: So you can say second of all.
segments.zh: 所以你可以说第二。

segments.en: Can you go like third of all, fourth of all?
segments.zh: 你能像三分之一一样去，第四吗？

segments.en: Not really, right?
segments.zh: 不是真的吗？

segments.en: You don't really say it.
segments.zh: 你真的不说。

segments.en: I guess you could, but.
segments.zh: 我想你可以，但是。

segments.en: So you go first of all, second of all, and then maybe just go and also.
segments.zh: 所以你首先去，其次，然后也许只是去。

segments.en: Or lastly.
segments.zh: 或者最后。

segments.en: And then lastly to end it.
segments.zh: 然后最后结束它。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: Now, one of the other points that he talked about, well, apart from the one-on-one class was that the reason why a one-on-one class was better is because he could focus on his or her strengths and or weaknesses.
segments.zh: 现在，他谈到的其他要点之一，嗯，除了一对一的课程，一对一的课程更好的原因是因为他可以专注于他或她的长处或短处。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So strengths or weaknesses or strengths and weaknesses.
segments.zh: 所以优势或弱点或优势和劣势。

segments.en: This is a set phrase.
segments.zh: 这是一个固定的短语。

segments.en: And it's important to remember that these two words are opposites.
segments.zh: 重要的是要记住这两个词是对立的。

segments.en: So strengths, that's the things you're good at.
segments.zh: 所以优势，这就是你擅长的事情。

segments.en: And weaknesses.
segments.zh: 和弱点。

segments.en: Things you're bad at.
segments.zh: 你不擅长的事情。

segments.en: Things you're bad at.
segments.zh: 你不擅长的事情。

segments.en: And so, especially when you're studying in a school or you're homeschooling, it's important that the teacher understands the strengths and weaknesses of the student.
segments.zh: 因此，尤其是当您在学校学习或在家上学时，老师了解学生的优势和劣势非常重要。

segments.en: Because something that you're really good at, maybe you should encourage and something you're bad at, you should work harder at improving.
segments.zh: 因为你真正擅长的事情，也许你应该鼓励和你不擅长的事情，你应该更加努力地改进。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So it's usually fixed phrase.
segments.zh: 所以它通常是固定的短语。

segments.en: You'll even get it in job interviews.
segments.zh: 你甚至会在工作面试中得到它。

segments.en: Somebody will say, well, what do you think are your strengths and weaknesses?
segments.zh: 有人会说，好吧，你认为你的长处和短处是什么？

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So remember that phrase, strengths and weaknesses.
segments.zh: 所以记住这句话，优点和缺点。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And lastly, he said that, well, even though the idea is interesting, it might be difficult to make the parents or the grandparents agree with him.
segments.zh: 最后，他说，好吧，尽管这个想法很有趣，但可能很难让父母或祖父母同意他的观点。

segments.en: So he said he will bring it up over Sunday brunch.
segments.zh: 所以他说他会在周日早午餐时提出。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: I will bring it up.
segments.zh: 我会提出来的。

segments.en: Bring it up.
segments.zh: 提起它。

segments.en: Well, you're not actually holding something.
segments.zh: 好吧，你实际上并没有拿着什么东西。

segments.en: This means that you will mention it in conversation.
segments.zh: 这意味着您将在对话中提及它。

segments.en: Mention the topic, right?
segments.zh: 提起话题对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So maybe grandma and grandpa don't think homeschooling is a good idea, but you will discuss it or you will suggest it during Sunday brunch.
segments.zh: 所以也许奶奶和爷爷不认为在家上学是个好主意，但你会讨论它，或者你会在周日早午餐时提出建议。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So if you want to discuss a topic, you usually say, I will bring it up with the president, for example.
segments.zh: 所以如果你想讨论一个话题，你通常会说，例如，我会向总统提出这个话题。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: You will talk about it with the president.
segments.zh: 你会和总统谈谈这件事。

segments.en: You can also say, please don't bring it up.
segments.zh: 你也可以说，请不要提起它。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So maybe you told a secret and you don't want the other person to know and you say, okay, please Marco, don't bring it up.
segments.zh: 所以也许你告诉了一个秘密，你不想让别人知道，你说，好吧，Marco，不要提起它。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Let's listen to our dialogue one last time.
segments.zh: 我们最后再听一遍对话。

segments.en: I think we should homeschool our children when we decide to have kids.
segments.zh: 以后有了孩子，我觉得我们应该让他们在家接受教育。

segments.en: What?
segments.zh: 什么？

segments.en: Why?
segments.zh: 为什么？

segments.en: Well, our public schools here are not very good and private schools are just too expensive.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们这里的公立学校不是很好，私立学校也太贵了。

segments.en: I have been reading up on some homeschooling and it has a lot of advantages.
segments.zh: 我一直在阅读一些家庭教育，它有很多优势。

segments.en: Like what?
segments.zh: 比如什么？

segments.en: I think that by doing something like that, we would be isolating our children from social interaction.
segments.zh: 我认为通过做这样的事情，我们会将我们的孩子与社交互动隔离开来。

segments.en: Well, first of all, I would be able to teach them everything they learn in school in a more relaxed and fun way.
segments.zh: 好吧，首先，我可以以更轻松、更有趣的方式教他们在学校学到的一切。

segments.en: I also think that having a one-on-one class is much better since you can focus more on his or her strengths or weaknesses.
segments.zh: 而且一对一教学更好，可以针对孩子的长处和弱项来教。

segments.en: I think neither your parents or mine would agree to such an idea.
segments.zh: 我觉得你我两边的父母都不会同意。

segments.en: I'll bring it up over Sunday brunch.
segments.zh: 周日吃早午餐时，我会提起这事。

segments.en: Good luck with that.
segments.zh: 那祝你好运。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So homeschooling is a very interesting option.
segments.zh: 所以在家上学是一个非常有趣的选择。

segments.en: I think it's very common, more common nowadays in Britain and North America.
segments.zh: 我认为这很常见，在英国和北美现在更为普遍。

segments.en: But how do people that are homeschooled go to college if they didn't go to a high school?
segments.zh: 但是，在家上学的人如果没有上高中，他们如何上大学呢？

segments.en: Well, I believe that most people when they finish homeschooling will take some tests to prove that they've actually learned the material that is required by the state.
segments.zh: 好吧，我相信大多数人在完成家庭教育时会进行一些测试，以证明他们实际上已经学习了国家要求的材料。

segments.en: Because, you know, in America, each state sets the educational standards.
segments.zh: 因为，你知道，在美国，每个州都设定了教育标准。

segments.en: And so it's important that you learn certain science and math skills.
segments.zh: 因此，学习某些科学和数学技能很重要。

segments.en: And then once you take those tests, you would get your GED, your graduate diploma.
segments.zh: 然后，一旦您参加了这些考试，您将获得您的 GED，您的研究生文凭。

segments.en: And that means that you've learned everything that a high school student should know.
segments.zh: 这意味着你已经学会了高中生应该知道的一切。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So it's interesting because it would seem a little bit strange to not want your kid to go to school.
segments.zh: 所以这很有趣，因为不想让你的孩子去上学会有点奇怪。

segments.en: But at the same time, there are many reasons why parents don't want their kids to go to school.
segments.zh: 但与此同时，父母不希望孩子上学的原因有很多。

segments.en: Like in this dialogue, maybe the schools are not really good or too expensive.
segments.zh: 就像在这个对话中一样，也许学校不是很好或太贵。

segments.en: What do you think about homeschooling?
segments.zh: 你怎么看待在家上学？

segments.en: Would you send your kids to homeschool?
segments.zh: 你会把你的孩子送到家里上学吗？

segments.en: I don't think I would do homeschooling because I think it's really important for students to or for children to learn how to get along with others and to learn to negotiate and to learn to play and to also learn to respect their teachers because you have a different relationship with your parents than you do your teachers.
segments.zh: 我不认为我会在家上学，因为我认为学生或孩子学习如何与他人相处、学习谈判和学习玩耍以及学习尊重他们的老师真的很重要，因为你与父母的关系与你的老师不同。

segments.en: And I think there's a lot of valuable social lessons you can learn at school.
segments.zh: 我认为你可以在学校学习很多有价值的社交课程。

segments.en: But I do understand why a lot of people choose this option, especially if the schools in their area are poor performing schools so that the students aren't learning enough.
segments.zh: 但我确实理解为什么很多人会选择这个选项，特别是如果他们所在地区的学校表现不佳，以至于学生学习不够。

segments.en: Or if maybe they're not safe because some schools there's some bullying or there's some violence.
segments.zh: 或者如果他们不安全，因为有些学校有一些欺凌或有一些暴力。

segments.en: And so for those reasons, I definitely understand the motivation to do homeschooling.
segments.zh: 因此，出于这些原因，我绝对理解在家上学的动机。

segments.en: But then again, you can't.
segments.zh: 但话又说回来，你不能。

segments.en: I mean, you can get homeschooled from kindergarten all the way through high school, right?
segments.zh: 我的意思是，你可以从幼儿园到高中一直在家上学，对吧？

segments.en: But there is no homeschooling for university unless you do like an online degree or something like that.
segments.zh: 但是除非你喜欢在线学位或类似的东西，否则大学没有在家上学。

segments.en: You can't really be homeschooled for college.
segments.zh: 你真的不能在家上大学。

segments.en: No, there's distance courses so you could use the internet and learn online.
segments.zh: 不，有远程课程，因此您可以使用互联网和在线学习。

segments.en: But no, you can't homeschool for university.
segments.zh: 但是不，你不能在家上大学。

segments.en: It's a very debatable topic.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常有争议的话题。

segments.en: A lot of people defend it saying it's good.
segments.zh: 很多人为它辩护说它很好。

segments.en: It brings parents closer together to their kids, that kids enjoy learning, that they learn better, etc.
segments.zh: 它使父母更接近他们的孩子，孩子们喜欢学习，他们学习得更好，等等。

segments.en: Other people don't really agree with it.
segments.zh: 其他人并不认同它。

segments.en: So what is your opinion?
segments.zh: 那么你的意见是什么？

segments.en: Do you agree with homeschooling?
segments.zh: 你同意在家上学吗？

segments.en: Our website is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 我们的网站是 EnglishPod.com。

segments.en: We hope to hear your arguments there.
segments.zh: 我们希望在那里听到你的论点。

segments.en: Okay, we'll see you there.
segments.zh: 好的，我们会在那里见到你。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
